title: EgoNeMo: Transferable Map of Pedestrian Dynamics via Egocentric LiDAR Scan
abstract: arXiv:2609.06195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a transferable Map of Dynamics (MoD) framework that generalizes to unknown environments using only egocentric 3D LiDAR point clouds to overcome the long-standing limitation of traditional MoD methods. While MoDs are essential for encoding human motion characteristics to enable accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction or safe robot navigation, traditional approaches suffer from site-specificity, requiring exhaustive trajectory accumulation at every new location. Extending recent advances in neural implicit modeling, our framework trains a continuous, LiDAR-based MoD estimator across diverse environments. To mitigate the inherent sparsity and temporal bias of real-world trajectory data, we introduce a position-balanced sampling strategy and a multi-task learning architecture that jointly predicts motion distributions and a spatial frequency score map. translated_title: EgoNeMo：基于自我中心激光雷达扫描的可迁移行人动态地图
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种可迁移的动态地图框架，该框架仅使用自我中心的3D激光雷达点云即可泛化到未知环境，从而克服了传统动态地图方法的长期局限。尽管动态地图对于编码人类运动特征、实现准确的行人轨迹预测或安全的机器人导航至关重要，但传统方法存在特定场所的局限，需要在每个新位置进行详尽的轨迹积累。基于神经隐式建模的最新进展，我们的框架在多样化环境中训练出一个连续的、基于激光雷达的动态地图估计器。为了缓解真实世界轨迹数据固有的稀疏性和时间偏差，我们引入了位置平衡采样策略和多任务学习架构，该架构联合预测运动分布和空间频率分数图。后者进一步通过视点感知损失进行增强，以补偿……
tldr: 本文提出EgoNeMo框架，仅利用自我中心激光雷达点云训练连续的行人动态地图，结合位置平衡采样、多任务学习与视点感知损失，使动态地图能够泛化到未知环境，无需在每个新地点积累轨迹数据。
en_tdlr: EgoNeMo introduces a transferable Map of Dynamics framework trained solely on egocentric LiDAR point clouds, leveraging position-balanced sampling, multi-task learning, and visibility-aware losses to generalize pedestrian dynamics modeling to unseen environments without site-specific trajectory accumulation.
